title: Automated teller machine transaction logs
definition: The terminal-level log of cash withdrawals and deposits, showing the terminal, the location, the time and the amount. It is requested where a dispersion pattern is being assessed, and it establishes the physical dispersion of cash movements, which a summary of the account cannot show.
evidence_to_cite: the terminal logs, with the terminals covered and the period
the terminal location reference used, and how it was resolved
the linkage between the terminal and the account

sources.citation: Terminal-level records used in the assessment of cash activity, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
